svg.title: KDS
svg.desc: KDS: A decision support system for hospitals and healthcare institutions. What it does: Web-based analytics and reporting for hospital managers and physicians. 18 modules, including physician performance scores, clinic and patient traffic, treatment groups, revenue, stock, referrals, radiology and prosthesis tracking. Connects to hospital information systems through SQL Server. Interactive Plotly dashboards, with stock movement details in pop-ups. AES-256 encrypted data storage, and deployment as a Windows service with Waitress. Built with: Python, Flask, pyodbc, SQL Server, pandas, Plotly, JavaScript, Waitress, PyCryptodome.
